Interface ClientServerCommand

All Superinterfaces:
Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbandonRaceCommand, AttachComponentCommand, CreateGameCommand, DrawCardCommand, DrawFaceDownComponentCommand, DrawFaceUpComponentCommand, DrawFromReservedCommand, EndAssemblePhaseCommand, EndCrewPlacingPhaseCommand, GetFaceUpComponentListCommand, GetSubDeckCommand, IncrementCommand, JoinGameCommand, LeaveGameCommand, PingCommand, PlaceCrewMemberCommand, PlaceRocketCommand, PutDownComponentCommand, RemoveComponentCommand, RollDiceCommand, SetCardContextCommand, SetEffectContextCommand, SetGameLevelCommand, SetMaxPlayersCommand, SetNicknameCommand, ShowShipCommand, StartFinalHourGlassCommand, StartHourGlassCommand, ViewGameCommand
public interface ClientServerCommand extends Serializable
Represents a command that can be sent from a client to the server. All client-server commands must implement this interface to ensure they can be executed by the SocketServer.

  • Method Details

    • execute

      void execute(SocketServer server) throws Exception
      Executes the command on the provided SocketServer instance. This method defines the action to be performed on the server side when this command is received.
      Parameters:
      server - The SocketServer instance to execute the command on.
      Throws:
      Exception - if an error occurs during command execution.
